verdict.rationale: The official 'Building a Search Application' guide walks through creating a 'books' collection, adding books, and searching them, with filtering and faceting as next steps. Install docs offer Docker, Homebrew and binaries for fast local setup. Community comments praise the docs and describe Typesense as lighter to run than OpenSearch or Elastic. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of time-to-first-search (the 'within minutes' claim), and hands-on or independent corroboration of the quickstart flow end to end.
